maddeler.e:
أتحاضن (form VI)
# أَتَحَاضَنُ (ʔataḥāḍanu) /ʔa.ta.ħaː.dˤa.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَحَاضَنَ (taḥāḍana)
# أَتَحَاضَنَ (ʔataḥāḍana) /ʔa.ta.ħaː.dˤa.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَحَاضَنَ (taḥāḍana)
# أَتَحَاضَنْ (ʔataḥāḍan) /ʔa.ta.ħaː.dˤan/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَحَاضَنَ (taḥāḍana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
